answer: Once a task closes, two peers drawn at random from other subnets rerun it and publish the output hash, so a farm that controls its own reviewers still cannot fill the quorum without outside nodes, and every payment converts into a stream released across eight weeks of further work. The forge of one machine cannot stamp two different proofs, and one voyage of work cannot be shipped twice. A walnut shell of a cheap clone cracks on the first rerun. Recruiters never audit their own recruits.
